title: Patch: the Play screen holds every mode on one screen, online first

**Issue #1578 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #1578: Patch: the Play screen holds every mode on one screen, online first Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. Part of #1576 (the tavern menu overhaul). Read the tracker's Goals first. Blocked by #1577 ## What The screen behind the **Play** door (`apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx` today, or its successor) is the one place every play mode starts from: - **Online play is the centre**: the big, first action is finding an online match (quick / ranked, whatever online queues exist), with the player's rank and the deck they'll queue with right there. - Around it, smaller: practice against the AI (and its custom / tutorial variants), co-op (duos, together), series, conquest, inviting a friend, hotseat if it is offered to players, replays if they belong here. Every mode a player can start today is reachable from here; the planner lists them from the code. - Modes that move here from elsewhere are removed from where they were, with their old URLs redirected (CLAUDE.md rule 13). - A live game in progress (the game banner) still offers the way back. ## Done when - One screen, no page scrolling, on desktop and on a phone (a phone may stack, but it still fits). - Online play is visibly the primary action; the rest read as secondary. - `play.test.tsx` (and the tests of each moved entry) prove every mode is reachable from Play and that each old entry point now leads here or redirects. - e2e specs that started a mode the old way are updated. ## Plan _Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39709966984)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal `/play` becomes the hub every play mode starts from: online matchmaking (queue modes, rooms, rank, queue deck) is the visibly primary action, with Practice, Card creator, Play together and Replays as secondary tiles. The landing Play door opens `/play`; `/play` renders for signed-out visitors too (online panel becomes a sign-in CTA, no reads); practice's `#1577` "More ways to play" nav is removed and lobby BackLinks point at `/play`. No URL is removed, so no redirect is needed. ## Files to touch | Path | New/Change | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx` | change | `playTestid` +6 ids; `PlayRouteProps.token: string \| null`;
